body.name: Total algebraic survivor-capacity map
body.construction: For \(u,v\in\mathbb R\), set \(u\oslash v=u/v\) if \(v\ne0\) and \(u\oslash0=0\). For every \(q\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}\), set \(q_{xz}(q)=\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}q_{xza}\) and \(q_x(q)=\sum_{z,a}q_{xza}\). For \(k\in\mathcal Y\), define \(R_{0kx}(q)=q_{x0,(0,1,k)}\oslash q_{x0}(q)-q_{x1,(0,1,k)}\oslash q_{x1}(q)\) and \(R_{1kx}(q)=q_{x1,(1,1,k)}\oslash q_{x1}(q)-q_{x0,(1,1,k)}\oslash q_{x0}(q)\), and set \(H_x(q)=q_x(q)\{R_{0\cdot x}(q)_+,R_{1\cdot x}(q)_+\}\in\mathbb R^{2K}\). For every \((\ell,h)\in\mathbb R^{2K}\), let \(s_0=\sum_k\ell_k\), \(s_1=\sum_k h_k\), \(m(\ell,h)=\min(s_0,s_1)\), \(F_L(\ell,h)=\max\{0,\max_{0\le t<K}(\sum_{k\le t}\ell_k-\sum_{k\le t}h_k)+\min(s_1-s_0,0)\}\), and \(F_U(\ell,h)=\min\{m(\ell,h),\min_{0\le t<K}(\sum_{k<t}\ell_k+\sum_{k>t}h_k)\}\). Define \(\bar M(q)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}m\{H_x(q)\}\), \(\bar N_L(q)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}F_L\{H_x(q)\}\), and \(\bar N_U(q)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}F_U\{H_x(q)\}\), and use \(M(q)=\bar M(q)\).
